reasons.controls: Large separated touch buttons, tap aim and MOVE/FIRE simultaneous input worked at entry. Patrol drag/movement lost target visibility; automatic releases prevent continuous burst comfort assessment.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery, coil shutdown and uplink provide distinct tasks with clear progress. Assisted traversal dominated and manual patrol engagements lacked clear immediate confirmations; independent combat depth and sustained enjoyment remain unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Rain, industrial silhouettes, teal/orange lighting and consistent typography create a strong visual identity. Software WebGL images only; audio and hardware smoothness unassessed.
reasons.usability: Contextual HOLD ROUTE/APPROACH/RECOVER, map, OFF labels, upload percent and START FRESH made progression and restart clear.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo and key prompts readable at 844x390; distant patrols and environmental text small; dark structure and pillars can obscure targets.
